title: loxogramme makinoi
intro: Loxogramme makinoi, commonly known as the Makino's fern or Makino's climbing fern, is a species of fern in the family Loxogrammaceae. It is an evergreen epiphytic fern native to East Asia, valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Loxogramme makinoi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
